metadata.title: Product Bricks & Streams
metadata.description: Hierarchical product brick map for the transport-management-and-freight-exchange domain, modeled on Alpega Group: enterprise TMS for shippers, a pan-European freight-exchange network, connected execution, and the settlement, trust, and data products around them.

rootGroups.name: Shipper Products
rootGroups.description: Enterprise TMS capabilities for shippers running the Plan → Procure → Execute lifecycle: transport orders, load planning, carrier selection, freight procurement, and the contracted rates behind them.

subGroups.name: Planning and Execution Management
subGroups.description: From ERP order intake to an optimized, tendered load plan with an assigned carrier.

bricks.name: Transport Order Management
bricks.description: System of record for enterprise transport orders across FTL, LTL, and groupage moves in Europe. Ingests deliveries and stock-transfer orders from shipper ERPs and turns them into executable transport orders with loading points, time windows, equipment requirements, and dangerous-goods classifications. Tracks each order's lifecycle from creation through tendering, execution, and delivery confirmation, and is the anchor every downstream brick refers back to.

bricks.name: Transport Planning and Optimization
bricks.description: Consolidates ERP order lines into an optimized daily load plan: FTL load building, LTL and groupage consolidation, multi-stop routing, and truck-legal constraints such as weight, pallet spaces, and driving-time rules. Planners compare scenarios on cost and service before releasing the plan to tendering, cutting planner touches per load and avoidable empty kilometers.

bricks.name: Carrier Selection and Load Tendering
bricks.description: Selects the right carrier for each planned load by applying routing guides, contracted rate cards, and allocation shares, then runs cascade or broadcast tendering with acceptance deadlines. When contracted carriers reject, it falls through the routing guide and can escalate to the spot market, keeping tender acceptance visible per lane and per carrier.

rootGroups.name: Network and Carrier Products
rootGroups.description: The pan-European carrier network: spot freight exchanges, matching, the carrier-facing experience, and the vetting, trust, and payment-security services that make strangers safe to trade with.

bricks.name: Freight Exchange Marketplace
bricks.description: Pan-European spot freight exchange modeled on Teleroute, Wtransnet, and Bursa Transport: shippers, forwarders, and carriers post spot loads and free truck capacity, search, negotiate, and close deals. The network spans 80,000+ carriers across 80 countries with hundreds of thousands of freight transactions and offers daily, and every posting and deal is gated by membership and trust status so counterparties can trade safely.

bricks.name: Freight Matching and Recommendations

Saved search profiles and instant alerts push relevant offers to dispatchers, ranked by lane fit, price, timing, and counterparty trust score.
